lines: Haah... haah... Did she finally calm down...? What the hell is wrong with her...
Sonia was a true homicidal maniac.
Attacking us for her own pleasure, Sonia had been more vicious and tenacious than the UFS soldiers who were just following orders.
For the time being, we hadn't killed her.
We had wounded her so severely that she couldn't move, and then we had put her to sleep with Shizuru's poisonous flowers.
Aieeeee, she's passed out happily, completely covered in blood. Homicidal maniacs are super scary.
We ended up having to fight her, but what was that all about?
This time, even Shizuru was making a puzzled face.
There's no way to understand how a homicidal maniac thinks.
That's fine with me. Let's hand this homicidal maniac over to the UFS and go back to Gosha quickly. Or let's just leave her here.
I'd be okay with that, but it's up to you, Fuma-kun.
If we do that, she's going to get killed by the UFS.
But I guess it would leave a bad taste in your mouth, right, Fuma-kun?
Then what do you want to do?
Shizuru seemed somewhat amused. She might have already known my answer.
It is what it is. Let's take her home with us for now.
H-Hey, n-no way!! I don't want to go back with this psychopathic killer!
The mission doesn't end until we return home. She a little, well no, she's quite insane, but she's still in our unit. We can't just leave her like this.
Do you think this is a field trip?! You gotta be kidding!
I ignored Shikanosuke's shouts of "No! No!" and picked up the bloody Sonia once again.
I was called to the headmistress's office again.
I apologize for this. I got you and your team caught up in the internal problems of the UFS.
The always strict Asagi-sensei apologized to me.
We were in a real rough situation. By the way, what happened to that researcher?
In the end, the Japanese-looking researcher with the weird name, where both parts sounded like a surname, hadn't shown up.
It seems like he was eliminated. Sonia was just an extra target to kill during the operation.
And us Taimanin were an extra target on top of the extra target? What a pain.
Yes, I'm thinking of paying them back for this someday.
Asagi-sensei smiled. It was a scary smile, but in a different way from the smile of that homicidal maniac.
By the way, where is Sonia?
I didn't really want to ask... but still did.
I hadn't seen her since we had come back home and handed her over to Asagi-sensei.
She went back. Saying that her wounds had already healed.
Is she going to kill everyone who betrayed her?
Most likely. She seemed to be really looking forward to it.
I could picture the smile on her blood-covered face, and it sent a chill down my spine.
Ah, and this. A letter for you.
I had nothing but bad feelings.
I'm not as tactless as to read other people's love letters.
I didn't want to look at it, but I opened the envelope.
That was the gist of the letter, which had been written in English.
And it even had a bloody kiss mark.
Someone truly dreadful seems to have grown fond of you.
Even Asagi-sensei was sympathizing with me.
